summary: Innovative Industrial Properties (IIPR), a Maryland REIT, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Sixth Amendment to an Amended and Restated Mezzanine Loan and Security Agreement dated September 30, 2025, via a wholly owned operating partnership subsidiary, IIP Life Science Investments II LLC, as lender. Borrower is IQHQ-Alewife Holdings, LLC, a subsidiary of IQHQ, LP. The maximum principal amount increases by $267 million to $400 million; the registrant committed up to $245 million under Note B, while the existing mezzanine lender committed up to $22 million under Note C. Approximately $111 million was advanced at closing, repaying an existing $85 million bridge loan plus fees.
